headline: Global Stocks Drop Following U.S. Sell-Off Amid AI Spending Concerns
summary: Stock markets across Asia and Europe tumbled, with Japan's market entering a bear market, following a U.S. equity sell-off driven by artificial intelligence spending fears.
why: Broad market sell-offs driven by sector-specific valuation concerns can trigger global risk-off sentiment and impact international equity portfolios.
why_moved: Fears regarding heavy artificial intelligence spending triggered a sell-off in U.S. equities, which quickly spread to global markets across Asia and Europe.
